topic: How do MPLS and IPsec VPNs differ in mitigating congestion for real-time QoS in multi-telectric utility backbones?
consensus_response: MPLS provides better QoS guarantees through traffic aggregation, prioritization, and label switched paths, whereas IPsec VPNs rely on DiffServ. MPLS' approach enables enhanced scalability, admission control, and congestion mitigation by managing available capacity, making it more effective for real-time QoS in multi-utility backbones.
reference_context: MPLS and IPsec VPNs have different strengths in QoS provisioning, with MPLS offering better scalability and QoS guarantees through traffic aggregation.
